Communication services shares climbed by 2.2% on Thursday. Meanwhile, top gainers in the sector included  Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc.  (NASDAQ: CCOI), up 6%, and  Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ: FB), up 6%.
